name: anubis-monorepo
description: Monorepo root for the Anubis framework.

scripts.dev: docker compose -f starter/compose.yaml up -d --wait && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgres://app:app@localhost:54321/app_development APP_URL=http://localhost:5173 cargo run -p anubis-starter" "yarn workspace anubis-starter-frontend dev"
